#en: We'll need to find something to open that...
zh: 我们得找点东西来打开那个……

#en: Oh, right. When I try to be social, I'm doing it all wrong. But when someone else tries...
zh: 哦，对。我想表现得热络点就是全错了。可换了别人来试就……

#en: Hey... that Cyberamp you found on Mr. Knockoff Starborn. Just an idea, but why don't you put that on and then try opening the door...?
zh: 嘿……你在那个山寨星裔先生身上找到的赛博增幅。有个主意，你何不戴上它，然后再去开门……？

#en: There's gotta be some sort of key around here... Maybe Mr. Knockoff Starborn has something?
zh: 这附近肯定有某种钥匙……也许山寨星裔先生身上有？

#en: Addendum. Deviant Countermeasure 05 now authorized for field test use. 64% chance of permanent Deviant neutralization calculated. Further refinement advised.
zh: 补充说明。异常体反制手段05现已获准用于实地测试。经计算，永久消除异常体的概率为64%。建议进一步改良。

#en: Warning. Details regarding ongoing hardware development are classified.
zh: 警告。有关正在进行的硬件开发详情属于机密。

#en: Prohibited phrase detected. Please refrain from Deviant terminology. Correct hardware reference ID: Deviant Countermeasure 05. An artificial Astralgate.
zh: 检测到禁用措辞。请避免使用"异常体"这一措辞。正确的硬件引用编号：异常体反制手段05。人造星界之门。

#en: Ha... Are we surprised that it's locked?
zh: 哈……它锁着很意外吗？

#en: What are you, what am I speaking to?
zh: 你是什么，我在跟什么说话？

#en: Hm. If you wanted to guarantee that you trigger a self-destruct, the best way would be to find the station's Mainframe and attempt access.
zh: 嗯。如果你想确保触发自毁程序，最好的办法就是找到空间站的主机并尝试访问。

#en: This "Armillary" here, is this part of Watchtower's secret weapon?
zh: 这里的这座"浑天仪"，是瞭望塔秘密武器的一部分吗？

#en: Be advised. Any changes to station classification or operational purpose will be communicated through standard secure channels.
zh: 特此告知。空间站分级或行动目的的任何变更都将通过标准安全渠道传达。

#en: This station serves as a critical node to the inter-system threat network.
zh: 本站是星系间威胁网络的关键节点。

#en: Heimdall Station currently houses Watchtower detachment Delta 6 -- Deviant Capture & Containment division.
zh: 海姆达尔站目前驻扎着瞭望塔德尔塔6分队——异常体抓捕与收容部。

#en: You'll want to make orbit, fast. I don't think we've got much time.
zh: 你最好尽快进入轨道。我觉得我们时间不多了。

#en: The cloak's down, and I'm looking at one big station, with a lot of ships that are undocking and getting into formation...
zh: 隐形装置已失效，我看到一座巨大的空间站，还有很多飞船正在脱离对接、编队集结……

#en: Because Heimdall Station just appeared in front of me.
zh: 因为海姆达尔站就出现在我眼前。

#en: Okay, I think the Mainframe is through that door. Almost there...
zh: 好，我想主机就在那扇门后面。快到了……

#en: That was almost like fighting a real, fully-fledged Starborn.
zh: 那简直就像在跟一个真正的、货真价实的星裔战斗。

#en: Phew! However Watchtower are mimicking our abilities, looks like they're getting better at it.
zh: 呼！不管瞭望塔是怎么模仿我们能力的，看来他们越来越熟练了。

#en: How the hell have Watchtower given their people Starborn powers! Or at least, something close to 'em?!
zh: 瞭望塔到底怎么给他们的手下弄到星裔能力的！或者至少是接近的东西？！

#en: Oh great, not another one!
zh: 哦好啊，又来一个！

#en: This guy's using Starborn powers on us! Or at least, something close to 'em!
zh: 这家伙在对我们用星裔能力！或者至少是接近的东西！

#en: You're seeing this too, right?!
zh: 你也看到了，对吧？！

#en: We need to find a way to the Mainframe! Gren said that has the best chance of triggering the self-destruct!
zh: 我们得想办法去主机那里！格伦说那最有可能触发自毁程序！

#en: That's it! We have our path. C'mon! Let's get to that Mainframe!
zh: 就是它！有路走了。来吧！我们去主机那儿！

#en: I'll do my best to deal with any Watchtower reinforcements. Take care, and good luck.
zh: 我会尽力应付任何瞭望塔增援。保重，祝好运。

#en: Now's your chance. Dock before more ships arrive.
zh: 机会来了。趁更多飞船抵达前完成对接。

#en: You took too long. I detect new ships inbound.
zh: 你拖得太久了。我侦测到新飞船正在接近。

#en: Watchtower will likely have more ships inbound to assist. Your window to dock is closing.
zh: 瞭望塔很可能还有更多飞船前来支援。你的对接窗口正在关闭。

#en: Too late, more Watchtower ships. They'll need destroying before you can dock.
zh: 太迟了，又有瞭望塔飞船来了。你得先干掉它们才能对接。

#en: Yeah, I think so. Why else would they try to use it on us?
zh: 是啊，我想是吧。不然他们为什么要用它来对付我们？

#en: That's why you wanted to speak to Gren, right?
zh: 这就是你想找格伦谈的原因，对吧？

#en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

#en: ...I assume you just shut down the geothermal plant?
zh: ……我猜你刚把地热发电厂关掉了？

#en: Sure is! So what do you say, Gren? Can you offer any advice?
zh: 确实！那你怎么说，格伦？能给点建议吗？

#en: Anyway, let's go shut down this power plant. After you!
zh: 总之，我们去关掉这座发电厂吧。你先请！

#en: Hm. Maybe they launched that Skydrop out of sheer desperation! Could be a good sign! Shows they're scared. Maybe they'll make mistakes...
zh: 嗯。也许他们发射那次空投纯粹是出于绝望！这也许是个好兆头！说明他们害怕了。也许他们会犯错……

#en: Well, could be wrong, but whatever it was meant to be, I don't think Watchtower have perfected it yet... That was too easy! Relatively speaking.
zh: 嗯，也许我错了，但不管那本来应该是什么，我觉得瞭望塔还没把它完善……那太容易了！相对而言。

#en: Hah, speak for yourself! Oh. I suppose you did...
zh: 哈，你自己倒是没受伤！哦。我想你确实也没有……

#en: Bah, some "super weapon". It barely slowed me down.
zh: 呸，什么"超级武器"。几乎没拖慢我。

#en: Haha. Good old uncertainty...
zh: 哈哈。还是那熟悉的不确定性……

#en: This is Gren! I'm detecting Watchtower Skydrops -- inbound to your location.
zh: 我是格伦！我侦测到瞭望塔空投——正飞向你所在的位置。

#en: I'm not so sure about that. But it's possible.
zh: 这我不太确定。但有这个可能。

#en: That would stand to reason.
zh: 那倒说得通。

#en: You know, the "super-secret weapon" that a fleet won't defend us from?
zh: 你知道的，那个"超级秘密武器"，舰队也挡不住的那个？

#en: Just taking a stab in the dark here, but... that "Watchtower Armillary", do you think that could be the weapon they've been working on?
zh: 我这就瞎猜一下……那座"瞭望塔浑天仪"，你觉得那会不会就是他们一直在研制的那件武器？

#en: But I'll be okay! Thanks for checking up on me.
zh: 但我会没事的！谢谢你来看我。

#en: Yeah. Yeah, yeah, I'm fine. I'll admit, it's been a while since I used that many abilities, one right after another, and I might be just a little bit woozy...
zh: 是啊。是啊，是啊，我没事。我承认，我很久没这样连续使用那么多能力了，可能有点晕乎乎的……

#en: You used a lot of Starborn powers, are you okay?
zh: 你用了很多星裔能力，你还好吗？

#en: *sigh* No. No, that doesn't quite add up, does it...? More likely this is a response to our fleet strategy. No idea how they pulled it off, though.
zh: *叹气*不。不，这说不通，对吧……？这更可能是对我们舰队策略的回应。不过完全不知道他们是怎么做到的。

#en: Is this why they've been capturing Starborn, you think? To try and... reverse-engineer their powers into Skydrops?!
zh: 你觉得这就是他们一直抓星裔的原因吗？想试着……把他们的能力逆向仿造成空投？！

#en: Nope! First time... Suppose we shouldn't be shocked Watchtower have new types of Skydrop. I mean, they were bound to innovate.
zh: 没见过！第一次……不过我们也不该惊讶瞭望塔有空投的新型号。我是说，他们迟早会创新。

#en: Sure looked like one!
zh: 看起来确实像！

#en: Yeah. I think you're right about that.
zh: 是啊。我觉得你说得对。

#en: Have you ever seen a Skydrop like that before?
zh: 你以前见过那样的空投吗？

#en: I'm fairly sure that was an Armillary.
zh: 我挺肯定那是座浑天仪。

#en: That was an Armillary, no doubt about it.
zh: 那是座浑天仪，毫无疑问。

#en: That was Starborn tech, no question! Although, it looked... jury-rigged. Like a... like a bad knock-off.
zh: 那是星裔科技，毫无疑问！不过，它看起来……像临时拼凑的。像个……劣质仿冒品。

#en: *sigh* I don't know about you, but I didn't expect that at all!
zh: *叹气*我不知道你怎么想，但我完全没料到会这样！

#en: It's no use calling down a Skydrop! That device is giving off too much interference.
zh: 呼叫空投没用！那装置造成的干扰太大。

#en: Scanners show... Another Skydrop! It's big. And giving off some strange energy readings... Get ready, it'll be landing any second now.
zh: 扫描器显示……又一个空投！很大。而且散发出奇怪的能量读数……准备好，它随时会着陆。

#en: I'm unsure... I only noticed the Mech Skydrops once they entered the atmosphere. If they did come from Heimdall Station, then-- One second...
zh: 我不确定……我只在机甲空投进入大气层后才注意到它们。如果它们真是从海姆达尔站来的，那么——等一下……

#en: My ship is outfitted with a Skydrop system, but my loadout is limited. If you throw down a flare, I'll send down what I can.
zh: 我的飞船装有空投系统，但配载有限。你扔下曳光弹，我就把能派的都派下去。

#en: Hang on, I'm sending down a care package. Get ready for a Skydrop.
zh: 等等，我在投送一个补给包。准备接收空投。

#en: I notice you've met some resistance down there.
zh: 我注意到你在下面遇到了一些抵抗。

#en: I'll remain in orbit. I'll alert you if I see any Watchtower activity.
zh: 我会留在轨道上。一旦发现任何瞭望塔活动就通知你。

#en: I'll remain in orbit with your fleet. I'll alert you if I see any Watchtower activity.
zh: 我会和你的舰队一起留在轨道上。一旦发现任何瞭望塔活动就通知你。

#en: If they're aware, they've shown no sign of it. Still, we shouldn't loiter.
zh: 如果他们已经察觉，倒是没有任何迹象。不过，我们不该逗留。

#en: Much of Torin's plan is based on conjecture. If something goes wrong, you'll need instruction. I'm uniquely qualified to provide this, so I'm going as well.
zh: 托林的计划有很大一部分基于猜测。如果出了岔子，你需要有人指导。我最有资格提供指导，所以我也去。

#en: No. I have a vessel of my own. It is fully outfitted and ready for combat.
zh: 不。我自己有一艘飞船。它装备齐全，随时可以战斗。

#en: No. I have acquired a new vessel of my own. It is fully outfitted and ready for combat.
zh: 不。我自己搞到了一艘新飞船。它装备齐全，随时可以战斗。

#en: So it seems. In this particular case, I'd say it would take at least... six.
zh: 看来是。就这个具体情况而言，我想至少需要……六个。

#en: On that note, let's get going! Pyraas II awaits. I'll be hitching a ride with you again, hope you don't mind.
zh: 既然如此，我们出发吧！派拉斯II在等着。我又要搭你的顺风车了，希望你不介意。

#en: That's my old pack. It had a few upgrades over the years. Maybe you'll find it useful. Good luck! I hope I get to see you all again...
zh: 那是我以前的背包。这些年做过几次升级。也许你会觉得有用。祝好运！希望还能再见到你们大家……

#en: Well, I'm not going with you. After all, someone needs to stay here and keep an eye on Stardock! But, you might as well take this...
zh: 嗯，我不跟你们去。毕竟得有人留在这儿看着星坞！不过，这个你尽管拿去……

#en: Gren, you're coming too?
zh: 格伦，你也去？

#en: Well, thanks Gren! Do you need a ship or...?
zh: 嗯，谢谢你格伦！你需要飞船吗，还是……？

#en: Good! I'll-- Wait... What?!
zh: 好！我会——等等……什么？！

#en: Very well, I'll meet you there.
zh: 很好，我们在那儿见。

#en: Okay, then. We're heading to Pyraas II! Which you'll not be shocked to hear is in the Pyraas system. That's where we'll find Heimdall Station.
zh: 那好。我们前往派拉斯II！你听到也不意外，它就在派拉斯星系。我们会在那里找到海姆达尔站。

#en: Once that self-destruct goes off, probably won't have long to get back to your ship. But we'll cross that bridge when we come to it...
zh: 自毁程序一旦启动，我们大概没多少时间赶回你的飞船。但船到桥头自然直……

#en: Oh, there will be running! No doubt about that.
zh: 哦，肯定要跑！这毫无疑问。

#en: Hold on, I'm not ready for this yet.
zh: 等等，我还没准备好。

#en: And then we run for it, right?
zh: 然后我们就跑，对吧？

#en: I'll go into more detail once we're good to go. So, you ready to do this?
zh: 等我们准备就绪，我再详细说明。那么，你准备好行动了吗？

#en: We're going to cripple Watchtower by taking out their main headquarters.
zh: 我们要摧毁瞭望塔的总部，从而重创他们。

#en: Go get yourself prepared and talk to me again once you're ready.
zh: 去做好准备，准备好之后再来找我。

#en: I hear ya! This... This is a... a big thing we're doing.
zh: 我懂你的意思！这……这是我们……要做的一件大事。

#en: This had better be good, Torin...
zh: 最好是个好主意，托林……

#en: Hold on, what's the plan again?
zh: 等等，计划是什么来着？

#en: Then we find where this "Watchtower Mainframe" is and make a straight line for it! We keep pushing until Watchtower blinks, and activates the self-destruct.
zh: 然后我们找到这个"瞭望塔主机"的位置，直奔那里！我们一路猛攻，直到瞭望塔撑不住、启动自毁程序。

#en: After that, we get back in orbit and use our fleet to deal with any external resistance, then board the station itself.
zh: 之后，我们回到轨道，用舰队解决任何外部抵抗，然后登上空间站本体。

#en: First, we go to the planet that Heimdall Station orbits, land on it, and deactivate the geothermal plant that powers the station's cloak.
zh: 首先，我们去海姆达尔站所环绕的那颗行星，着陆，并关闭为空间站隐形装置供电的地热发电厂。

#en: Alright, given everything we've learned, the plan should go something like this...
zh: 好，根据我们了解到的一切，计划大概是这样……

#en: That is what we call enthusiasm! And it's what we like to see.
zh: 这才叫干劲！这正是我们想看到的。

#en: Hey! Watchtower's waiting for us. It's now or never! Or possibly, a little bit later...
zh: 嘿！瞭望塔在等我们。就现在，否则永远没机会！或者，也许稍晚一点……

#en: We'll need your fleet in tip-top condition for this. Every ship! Last chance to make any equipment adjustments or last-minute lineup changes...
zh: 为此我们需要你的舰队处于最佳状态。每一艘飞船！这是调整装备或最后更改编组的最后机会……

#en: I'm ready. Let's take Watchtower down.
zh: 我准备好了。我们把瞭望塔干掉。

#en: Find the station's main computer, slap the keyboard a few times, big boom. Got it.
zh: 找到空间站的主计算机，敲几下键盘，轰的一声。明白了。

#en: If that's what you'd prefer, I'll just take these...
zh: 如果你更愿意这样，那这些我就收下了……

#en: Hah! Told you! I've been thinking about this for a while. I just need to know the best way to get that self-destruct activated.
zh: 哈！我说了吧！这事我想了很久了。我只需要知道激活自毁程序的最佳办法。

#en: Huh. That actually is a good plan. Torin's right. If they breach enough of the station's security, an automated self-destruct will activate.
zh: 嗯。这确实是个好计划。托林说得对。如果他们突破空间站足够多的安保，自动自毁程序就会启动。

#en: All Watchtower technology has a self-destruct, right? The station's gotta have one too! And if a couple of hostiles happen to make it on board...?
zh: 所有瞭望塔科技都有自毁装置，对吧？空间站肯定也有！要是有几个敌人恰好登上了站……？

#en: I'm waiting...
zh: 我等着呢……

#en: ...How is that brilliant?! "Blow it up"? What even makes you think you can do that?!
zh: ……这怎么就高明了？！"炸掉它"？你凭什么觉得你能做到？！

#en: Dare I say, that the following is brilliant in its simplicity. We board the station -- and then blow it up!
zh: 恕我直言，下面这个计划简单得堪称高明。我们登站——然后把它炸掉！

#en: One minute. I don't think this'll take long...
zh: 等一分钟。我想这不会花太久……

#en: We attack Heimdall Station with our fleet, board it, and then finally we can enact the final part of my plan!
zh: 我们用舰队进攻海姆达尔站，登站，然后终于可以实施我计划的最后一步！

#en: Alright, let's hear it.
zh: 好，说来听听。

#en: Geothermal energy? Can you explain that to me?
zh: 地热能？你能给我解释一下吗？

#en: ..."Heimdall Station", did you call it?
zh: ……"海姆达尔站"，你是这么叫的？

#en: Then bye-bye cloak, back to orbit, and we'll attack...
zh: 然后隐形装置就拜拜了，我们回到轨道，然后进攻……

#en: Hah! Of course we can. We'll just land on the planet, find this "micro-geo" power plant thingy, and turn it off!
zh: 哈！当然可以。我们就降落到行星上，找到那个"微型地热"发电厂之类的东西，然后把它关掉！

#en: This method ensures a continuous power supply without the need for traceable fuel shipments. An elegant solution.
zh: 这种方法能确保持续供电，无需运送可被追踪的燃料。是个优雅的解决方案。

#en: This extracts heat and then converts it into usable power, which is then transferred to Heimdall Station via a microwave array.
zh: 它提取热量，再转化为可用电力，然后通过微波阵列传输到海姆达尔站。

#en: Specifically, the mantle, where temperatures can be extreme. Watchtower have installed a deep-drilling station on the planet's surface.
zh: 具体来说是地幔，那里的温度可能极高。瞭望塔在行星地表安装了一座深钻站。

#en: Energy derived from a planet's internal heat.
zh: 取自行星内部热量的能源。

#en: Watchtower's tapped the mantle of the planet Heimdall Station orbits.
zh: 瞭望塔钻取了海姆达尔站所环绕行星的地幔。

#en: Now that we know how they power it, can we disrupt the cloak?
zh: 既然我们知道他们怎么供能了，我们能破坏隐形装置吗？

#en: That's right. Geothermal energy. The power is transferred from the planet's surface to the station via a microwave array. Quite efficient.
zh: 没错。地热能。电力通过微波阵列从行星地表传输到空间站。效率相当高。

#en: Wait, are you talking about...
zh: 等等，你说的是……

#en: It's done, I found what we need. I know how they're powering the station cloak.
zh: 搞定了，我找到我们需要的东西了。我知道他们是怎么给空间站隐形装置供能的了。

#en: Good. I'll take those...
zh: 好。这些我收下了……

#en: Don't keep us on tenterhooks, how-- how are they doing it?!
zh: 别吊我们胃口，他们——他们到底是怎么做到的？！

#en: We just need some Computer Cores then, right?
zh: 那我们只需要一些计算机核心，对吧？

#en: [Give Cores] I've found enough Computer Cores.
zh: [交出核心]我找到了足够多的计算机核心。

#en: [Give Safe House Cores] I found these Cores in the Safe House.
zh: [交出安全屋核心]我在安全屋里找到了这些核心。

#en: [Give Cores] On second thought, take the Cores I already have.
zh: [交出核心]再想想，还是拿我已有的核心吧。

#en: [Give Cores] You're in luck, I already have six Cores. Here you go.
zh: [交出核心]你走运了，我已经有六个核心。给你。

#en: And would Watchtower be likely to keep these records on Computer Cores...?
zh: 瞭望塔会把这些记录存放在计算机核心里吗……？

#en: See you when you get back!
zh: 回来见！

#en: In the meantime, I'm going to stay here. I should really pick Gren's brain over a few more details...
zh: 与此同时，我会留在这里。我确实该再向格伦多打听些细节……

#en: It'll grant you access to the facility. Just be ready for a fight.
zh: 它会让你获准进入该设施。只是要准备好打一场。

#en: Otherwise, you can still always check the safe house on Kang III. Take this old keycard, just in case you change your mind.
zh: 否则，你随时可以去康III上的安全屋看看。拿着这张旧钥匙卡，以防你改变主意。

#en: If you need some locations, just check in with me, I'll see what I can do.
zh: 如果你需要一些地点，来找我，我会看看能帮上什么忙。

#en: I think I'll try to salvage Cores the old fashioned way.
zh: 我想我还是用老办法去打捞核心吧。

#en: Bear with me... We strike Watchtower right at the heart! Now, I know how that sounds! But with just a few details clarified, I think we can make it work!
zh: 听我说完……我们直捣瞭望塔的心脏！我知道这听起来很疯狂！但只要弄清几个细节，我觉得我们能办到！

#en: You can find the safe house on Kang III. Take this old keycard.
zh: 你可以在康III上找到安全屋。拿着这张旧钥匙卡。

#en: This facility sounds good. Where is it?
zh: 这处设施听起来不错。它在哪？

#en: Or you could always just hunt down Cores the old-fashioned way! There might still be a Listening Post or two out there.
zh: 或者你也可以老办法去打捞核心！外面也许还有一两个监听哨。

#en: Six should allow some trial and error, with one core to spare just in case. Just be glad I didn't ask you to bring me ten.
zh: 六个应该够试错，还能多出一个备用。你该庆幸我没让你拿十个来。

#en: In truth, I won't know how many Cores are needed -- until I try to extract the data we want.
zh: 说实话，在我尝试提取我们需要的数据之前，我也不知道需要多少个核心。

#en: Hah, typical Watchtower! Can't make anything easy, can they?
zh: 哈，瞭望塔的典型作风！他们就不能把事情弄简单点吗？

#en: If you feel up to the challenge, the safe house contained a number of Computer Cores. We used them for the fabrication of blueprints. Should still be there.
zh: 如果你愿意接受这个挑战，那座安全屋里存有一些计算机核心。我们曾用它们来制造蓝图。应该还在那里。

#en: This one was also abandoned. Terrormorph outbreak.
zh: 这一处也被废弃了。骇变兽爆发。

#en: Another Watchtower safe house, similar to the facility from which you retrieved the Control Node.
zh: 另一座瞭望塔安全屋，与你取回控制节点的那处设施类似。

#en: Hm. There is perhaps another way to acquire the information you need.
zh: 嗯。也许还有另一种办法能获取你需要的信息。

#en: Why six Cores? Why not seven or five?
zh: 为什么是六个核心？为什么不是七个或五个？

#en: Great, let me just grab those from you...
zh: 太好了，让我从你这儿拿过来……

#en: Like I said, you need a way to disable its cloak.
zh: 就像我说的，你需要一个能使其隐形装置失效的办法。

#en: You mean the cloak's power source? If the hardware was proprietary, then yes.
zh: 你是指隐形装置的动力源？如果那硬件是专有的，那么是的。

#en: I have enough Cores, but I'd rather not use them...
zh: 我有足够的核心，但我不太想用它们……

#en: I don't have that many Cores to hand.
zh: 我手头没那么多核心。

#en: I dunno, Torin. That seems ambitious.
zh: 我不知道，托林。这听着野心太大了。

#en: Indeed they would. Of course, you'd need to have known the information was there to even look for it.
zh: 他们确实会。当然，你得先知道有那条信息，才会去找它。

#en: Hmm. Probably something to do with the ducting in this section...
zh: 嗯。大概跟这一区的管道有关……

#en: And don't you give me that look, Torin! Wasn't exactly difficult, your voice kinda carries.
zh: 别用那种眼神看我，托林！这可不算难，你的嗓门挺大的。

#en: Think I overheard most of what you were talking about.
zh: 你们说的我大概都听到了。

#en: How long have you been listening?
zh: 你听了多久了？

#en: To cloak something as big as a station? That would require tremendous energy! More than any power core could ever generate.
zh: 要让一座空间站那么大的东西隐形？那需要惊人的能量！比任何能量核心能产生的都多。

#en: Call it what you want, you got a problem. You wanna get aboard this "Heimdall Station"? You need a way to disable its cloak.
zh: 随你怎么说，你遇到麻烦了。你想登上这座"海姆达尔站"？你就需要一个能让它隐形装置失效的办法。

#en: Hey, Gren? You think Watchtower would keep records on that kinda thing?
zh: 嘿，格伦？你觉得瞭望塔会保留那种东西的记录吗？

#en: No way Watchtower's powering this cloak using conventional means. If we just knew how, maybe we could disrupt it. Huh... We need info...
zh: 瞭望塔绝不可能用常规手段给这个隐形装置供能。只要我们弄清方式，也许就能破坏它。嗯……我们需要情报……

#en: We need to disable that cloak.
zh: 我们得让那个隐形装置失效。

#en: Any ideas, Harper?
zh: 有什么主意吗，哈珀？

#en: Harper! What are you doing here?!
zh: 哈珀！你在这儿干什么？！

#en: Uh, this is my home, remember? You think I don't notice when you three knuckleheads sneak off to plot something?
zh: 呃，这里是我家，记得吗？你以为你们三个笨蛋偷偷溜去密谋我会没察觉？

#en: Overall, I've been well. Thank you for asking.
zh: 总的来说，我一直挺好。谢谢你问起。

#en: I've been kept busy with station maintenance and the odd ship-related task. There was a minor issue with one of my implants, but it has been corrected.
zh: 我一直忙于空间站维护和偶尔的飞船相关任务。我有个植入体出了点小问题，不过已经修好了。

#en: I appreciate your inquiry. Few take the time to ask. You have more social grace than Torin, that's for sure...
zh: 感谢你的问候。很少有人会花时间来问。你比托林有礼貌多了，这倒是真的……

#en: Ugh, damn it. Well, it was still worth asking.
zh: 呃，该死。不过，问问总还是值得的。

#en: That you were able to think of such an obvious weakness, means they'll have thought of it too. They will have countermeasures in place.
zh: 你都能想到这么明显的弱点，说明他们也一定想到了。他们会有反制措施。

#en: They wouldn't have gone to the trouble of producing enough plating to cover an entire station, if a simple scan would so easily give them away.
zh: 如果一次简单的扫描就能轻易暴露他们，他们就不会费心生产足以覆盖整座空间站的装甲板。

#en: I might've agreed with you, if we weren't talking about Watchtower.
zh: 如果对象不是瞭望塔，我也许会同意你。

#en: So... What now?
zh: 那……现在怎么办？

#en: Surely we just use scanners to find the station?
zh: 我们直接用扫描器找到空间站不就行了？

#en: Haha! Yeah, uh, okay. Sorry...
zh: 哈哈！是啊，呃，好吧。抱歉……

#en: Torin, I understand you're speaking in some sort of code, and I respect your privacy. But there's no reason to be so weird about it.
zh: 托林，我明白你在用某种暗语说话，我尊重你的隐私。但没必要搞得这么古怪。

#en: If it gets rid of Watchtower, I'm all in.
zh: 只要能除掉瞭望塔，我全力支持。

#en: Alright. We'll wait for you here.
zh: 好。我们在这里等你。

#en: Yeah... My plan sorta relies on actually being able to SEE the station. So I... I don't know what to do.
zh: 是啊……我的计划多少得靠真的能"看见"那座空间站。所以我……我不知道该怎么办。

#en: I also remember the occasional mention of "Deviant transfers". I don't know why, but I always found that particular phrasing unsettling...
zh: 我还记得偶尔有人提到"异常体转移"。不知为何，我总觉得那个说法令人不安……

#en: From what I could piece together, the station was intended to be a "hub", a centralized command for a variety of operations.
zh: 据我拼凑出的信息，那座空间站被设计为一个"枢纽"，是各类行动的集中指挥点。

#en: As I said, I never personally visited Heimdall Station, but I do recall other Watchtower operatives discussing it in passing.
zh: 如我所说，我本人从未去过海姆达尔站，但我确实记得其他瞭望塔特工顺口提起过。

#en: A lofty goal. And how exactly do you intend to achieve that?
zh: 目标很高远。那你究竟打算怎么实现？

#en: Or maybe it was different then; there wasn't a cloak because... you know... "reasons". Unity-type reasons...
zh: 也许那时候不一样；之所以没有隐形装置，是因为……你知道的……"某些原因"。跟归一有关的原因……

#en: I dunno! I was busy escaping... I guess I didn't bother to look behind me.
zh: 我不知道！我当时忙着逃跑……大概没顾上回头看。

#en: That's your plan? Are you kidding me?
zh: 这就是你的计划？你在开玩笑吧？

#en: Torin, how did you not notice the station was invisible?
zh: 托林，你怎么会没注意到那座空间站是隐形的？

#en: Can you tell us any more about this Watchtower starstation?
zh: 关于这座瞭望塔星际站，你还能告诉我们更多吗？

#en: I've seen similar use of this technique in some spacesuits. Smaller scale, but still just as useful.
zh: 我在一些太空服上见过类似的技术应用。规模更小，但同样实用。

#en: The result is most effective when motion is minimized. Rapid movement can cause distortions and imperfections in the illusion.
zh: 当移动被降到最低时效果最佳。快速移动会在幻象中造成扭曲和瑕疵。

#en: It captures and redirects light along the surface, allowing an object to blend seamlessly with its surroundings.
zh: 它能捕捉并沿表面重新导引光线，使物体与周围环境浑然一体。

#en: The plating was composed of a layered composite. Adaptive optical fibers interwoven with reactive polymers.
zh: 那装甲板由多层复合材料构成。自适应光纤与反应性聚合物交织在一起。

#en: I'd like to know more about this hull plating.
zh: 我想更多了解这种船体装甲板。

#en: Sorry, Torin. Seems your plan won't work.
zh: 抱歉，托林。看来你的计划行不通。

#en: The station you're looking for, Heimdall, was built to not be seen. Even if you know roughly where it is, you'd still never find it.
zh: 你要找的那座空间站——海姆达尔，生来就是为了不被看见。即便你大致知道它在哪，你也永远找不到它。

#en: It would be "cloaked", much like an Old Earth chameleon. Only better.
zh: 它会是"隐形"的，很像旧地球的变色龙。而且更胜一筹。

#en: An object making use of adaptive optical fiber, if it were to remain stationary enough, would be virtually invisible.
zh: 采用自适应光纤的物体，只要能保持足够静止，就几乎完全不可见。

#en: And a valuable station, at that.
zh: 而且还是座很有价值的空间站。

#en: No one said what the hull plating was for. But the technical specs, and the sheer volume requested, could only be for a starstation.
zh: 没人说那船体装甲板是做什么用的。但技术规格和所要求的巨大数量，只能是用于一座星际站。

#en: But if you paid attention, you could often infer quite a lot.
zh: 但只要留心，往往能推断出很多。

#en: As you're aware, Watchtower keeps a tight rein on information. Even high-ranking members know little about the organization or its assets.
zh: 如你所知，瞭望塔对信息严加管控。即便是高层成员，对这个组织或其资产也知之甚少。

#en: Are you telling me they've cloaked an entire starstation?
zh: 你是说他们让整整一座星际站隐形了？

#en: How do you know the plating was used on this station?
zh: 你怎么知道那些装甲板用在了这座空间站上？

#en: I see you understand, and you're right...
zh: 看来你明白了，你说得对……

#en: So... what are you saying?
zh: 所以……你想说什么？

#en: That sort of tech is primarily used for only one thing. Visual cloaking.
zh: 那种技术基本上只有一个主要用途。视觉隐形。

#en: Years ago, when I was still with Watchtower, I was ordered to fabricate a lot of hull plating. Plating that incorporated adaptive optical fiber technology.
zh: 多年前，我还在瞭望塔时，曾被命令制造大量船体装甲板。那批装甲板采用了自适应光纤技术。

#en: The station you speak of, I've never visited, but I have worked on components for its construction. It was called "The Heimdall Project".
zh: 你说的那座空间站，我从未去过，但我参与过其建造部件的制作。它被称为"海姆达尔计划"。

#en: Allow me to explain...
zh: 让我解释一下……

#en: So much for your "plan", Torin.
zh: 你的"计划"算是完了，托林。

#en: Why couldn't we find the station?
zh: 我们为什么找不到那座空间站？

#en: If you're talking about where I think you are, it doesn't matter if you know where it is. You'd still never be able to find it.
zh: 如果你说的是我以为的那个地方，那么知不知道它在哪都没用。你永远不可能找到它。

#en: You don't understand...
zh: 你不明白……

#en: Huh? Why not? I escaped from there, I remember what planet it was orbiting!
zh: 嗯？为什么不行？我是从那儿逃出来的，我记得它环绕的是哪颗行星！

#en: Wait... You were held captive...? But, yes, you are right. Although, it won't work. You won't be able to find that station.
zh: 等等……你曾被关押……？不过，是的，你说得对。然而，这行不通。你找不到那座空间站。

#en: So, if Gren can confirm that I'm right, we take our fleet, and we--
zh: 那么，如果格伦能证实我是对的，我们就带上舰队，然后我们——

#en: I'm talking "main base of operations" big. I'd bet anything that's their headquarters. And I know where that station is. Well, where it was.
zh: 我说的是"主要行动基地"那种大。我赌什么都可以，那就是他们的总部。而且我知道那座空间站在哪。嗯，它曾经在哪。

#en: Remember me telling you how Watchtower held me captive in a starstation? Well, that place was big. Like, REALLY big.
zh: 记得我跟你说过瞭望塔把我关在一座星际站里吗？那地方很大。真的非常大。

#en: You're back.
zh: 你回来了。

#en: Gren! Old buddy, good pal, dear friend to all--
zh: 格伦！老伙计，好哥们，大家的好朋友——

#en: Good to see you! Hope you're ready now.
zh: 很高兴见到你！希望你现在准备好了。

#en: Not all of it, just hear me out!
zh: 不全是，你听我说完！

#en: I dunno know why my powers aren't working, but right now, I don't care. I just wanna get out of here.
zh: 我不知道为什么我的能力不管用了，但眼下我不在乎。我只想离开这儿。

#en: I know, but just listen. There's more...
zh: 我知道，但你听我说。还有更多……

#en: Hah! Well, uh, hopefully you like the rest of the plan even more...
zh: 哈！嗯，呃，希望你更喜欢计划的其余部分……

#en: Hold on, I need to go do something. I'll be right back.
zh: 等等，我得去做点事。马上回来。

#en: Go ahead, Torin. Let's hear your plan.
zh: 说吧，托林。听听你的计划。

#en: So, kinda drastic, but I think we need to take Watchtower out of the picture. The sooner, the better.
zh: 嗯，有点激进，但我觉得我们得把瞭望塔从棋盘上拿掉。越快越好。

#en: I won't bore Gren by rehashing the details, but suffice it to say, our fleet strategy? It bought us time, but that time's running out.
zh: 我就不跟格伦重复细节了，但简单说，我们的舰队策略？它为我们争取了时间，但那时间快用完了。

#en: Before we talk, how have you been, Gren?
zh: 在谈之前，你最近怎么样，格伦？

#en: As I was saying... We need your help with Watchtower, Gren.
zh: 就像我说的……我们需要你帮忙对付瞭望塔，格伦。

#en: Ah. Right, sorry. It's Watchtower, Gren. They're coming for us. I have a plan, but I need some guidance from you first.
zh: 啊。对，抱歉。是瞭望塔，格伦。他们来找我们了。我有个计划，但得先听听你的指点。

#en: Torin!
zh: 托林！

#en: Haha, that's our Gren. Straight to the point! You know, I think that's what makes him such a great--
zh: 哈哈，这才是我们的格伦。直奔主题！你知道，我觉得这正是他成为这么出色的——

#en: Please, just... stop. What do you need, Torin?
zh: 拜托，就……别说了。你需要什么，托林？

#en: There, see? I unsealed the way. Now, just take what you want and go. My crew won't cause you any trouble.
zh: 看，瞧见没？我把路打开了。现在，拿上你想要的赶紧走。我的人不会给你添麻烦。

#en: Hm? There something you need...?
zh: 嗯？你需要点什么吗……？

#en: Torin here. Got a minute? There's something we should discuss.
zh: 我是托林。有空吗？有件事我们该谈谈。

#en: That's quite a few ships. Wasn't expecting such a large welcoming committee.
zh: 飞船还真不少。没想到会有这么大的欢迎阵仗。

#en: We gotta take care of the Spacer ships before we can board the station.
zh: 我们得先解决太空劫匪的飞船，才能登上空间站。

#en: We gotta take care of the Marauder ships before we can board the station.
zh: 我们得先解决劫掠者的飞船，才能登上空间站。

#en: Nothing we can't handle! We got this.
zh: 没什么我们搞不定的！交给我们。

#en: Alright, nice work! The way's clear. Lets dock with the station and find that database.
zh: 好，干得漂亮！路清出来了。我们与空间站对接，找到那个数据库。

#en: Ah, good timing! Please, take a seat. Not long finished pulling what we can from that Watchtower database.
zh: 啊，来得正是时候！请坐。我们刚从那个瞭望塔数据库里提取完能提取的东西。

#en: Hey, got a few minutes? There's something we should talk about.
zh: 嘿，有空吗？有件事我们该谈谈。

#en: Is now a good time to talk?
zh: 现在是谈话的好时机吗？

#en: Don't mean to bug you, but...
zh: 不想打扰你，不过……

#en: I wanna talk with you.
zh: 我想和你谈谈。

#en: Meet me back at Stardock. We'll talk more there.
zh: 回星坞找我。我们到那儿再细谈。

#en: We're not far off now. Let's just keep moving.
zh: 我们就快到了。继续走吧。

#en: The Watchtower database is still waiting for us.
zh: 瞭望塔数据库还在等我们。

#en: I need to board your ship! Dock with me so we can get going already.
zh: 我需要上你的飞船！跟我对接，我们好赶紧出发。

#en: Oh, and um, I guess your friend now too... Hi, by the way.
zh: 哦，还有，呃，我想现在还有你朋友……顺便说声，你好。

#en: Oh, and um, I guess your friends now too... Hi, by the way.
zh: 哦，还有，呃，我想现在还有你朋友们……顺便说声，你们好。

#en: There. I unsealed the way. Now get outta my sight.
zh: 好了。我把路打开了。现在别让我再看见你。

#en: In short, a version of you saved my life. In a previous universe I was captured by Watchtower. But another Starborn prisoner freed me. That was you.
zh: 简单说，一个版本的你救了我的命。在上一个宇宙里，我被瞭望塔抓获。但另一名星裔囚犯放了我。那就是你。

#en: Indefinite incarceration and... experimentation. And that's where I'd still be if another Starborn prisoner hadn't taken pity on me.
zh: 无限期监禁，还有……实验。要不是另一名星裔囚犯可怜我，我现在还会在那里。

#en: Not "you" you, but another you. You see, in my previous universe I was captured by Watchtower. There was no explanation, no trial, no jury, just...
zh: 不是"你"这个你，而是另一个你。你知道，在我的上一个宇宙里，我被瞭望塔抓获。没有解释，没有审判，没有陪审团，只有……

#en: The simple answer is, you saved my life.
zh: 简单的答案是，你救了我的命。

#en: Thanks to the info from that database, I know what they're planning. And it's not something we should ignore...
zh: 多亏那个数据库里的情报，我知道他们在谋划什么。而这不是我们能置之不理的……

#en: We still have our Watchtower problem.
zh: 我们还有瞭望塔这个麻烦。

#en: So, elephant in the room. Me! And my status as Starborn. Not too sure how to start this, really... Um, any ideas?
zh: 那么，说说明摆着的事吧。我！还有我星裔的身份。其实不太知道该怎么开口……呃，有什么主意吗？

#en: Speaking of, I think it's long past time you got some answers yourself.
zh: 说起来，我想你早该得到一些答案了。

#en: Uncovered plenty of interesting tidbits! And a few answers to some lingering questions.
zh: 挖出了不少有趣的料！也解答了一些萦绕已久的问题。

#en: No problem, I did just throw a lot at you. Besides, as my mom would always say "Haste makes waste". Meaning, we shouldn't rush. We still have time.
zh: 没事，我刚才是塞给你一堆东西。再说，我妈总说"欲速则不达"。意思是，我们别急。我们还有时间。

#en: Hey! I'm still concerned about Watchtower, we need to do some recon. You up for an adventure?
zh: 嘿！我还是担心瞭望塔，我们得做点侦察。想来场冒险吗？
